newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish unemployment seen down to 12 pct by mid-97.
newsitem.headline: Polish unemployment seen down to 12 pct by mid-97.

text.p: More public works could help to reduce Polish unemployment to about 12 percent in mid-year from 13.0 percent in March, Labour Minister Tadeusz Zielinski said on Monday.
He said the works would be aimed mainly at improving public infrastructure in areas of highest unemployment, as well as planting forests and maintaining waterways.
"We would like the unemployment rate to be no higher than 12 percent in mid-year," Zielnski told a news conference, adding the target was ambitious.
"According to preliminary research, the rate should keep falling in April and remain in a downward trend until July," he said.
He said the ministry wanted to keep the rate on the decline through tighter control of the eligibility of those claiming unemployment benefits.
